stem.text: Which row correctly shows the behaviour of the nuclear envelope, the centrioles and the spindle during a stage of mitosis?

A.text:
prophase; disappears; replicate; spindle microtubules
begin to form

B.text:
metaphase; not present; begin to move to
poles of cell; spindle microtubules
fully formed

C.text:
anaphase; begins to reform; at opposite
poles of the cell; some spindle
microtubules shorten

D.text:
telophase; reforms; one beside
each nucleus; spindle microtubules
break down

B:
begin to move to
poles of cell
C:
at opposite
poles of the cell
